cuts.head: with_body
cuts.ofreeRecent: a moonlit lotus pond with stepping stones and glowing fireflies — sitting on the ground; a terrace on a castle wall overlooking the valley — seated sideways on a stool or bench; her living room with a deep sofa — holds a magnifying glass by its handle at chest height; a present-day coastal tidal bathing pool carved into pale limestone — standing on a dry step after a swim; a modern glass-walled office at dusk — holds a cup in both hands; the Changban Bridge memorial — holds a red oil-paper umbrella open over her shoulder; a present-day outdoor orchard picnic clearing on a sunny hillside — taking a first bite of a peach after a long walk; a medieval tavern — seated on a chair; terraced tea fields on a misty Sichuan hillside — standing; inside a general's command tent — eats from a bowl of hot food set on the table in front of her; a neon-lit game arcade — seated on a chair; a floating sky garden of hanging vines and flowering terraces above the clouds — sitting on the ground; a vast fantasy library of towering shelves — holds her keepsake up beside her face
